verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.temporal.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 as a structured index of Temporal's documentation following the llmstxt convention. Docs pages are also served as raw markdown (e.g. encyclopedia/temporal-client.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or other full-content agent bundle, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs effectively.
